name: Sweet and Sour Pork

ingredients.name: pork shoulder
ingredients.original: 600 g pork shoulder, trimmed and cut into 3 cm pieces

ingredients.name: canned pineapple pieces
ingredients.original: 440 g can pineapple pieces in juice, drained, 60 ml juice reserved

ingredients.name: vegetable oil
ingredients.original: 500 ml vegetable oil, for shallow frying

steps: Rinse the jasmine rice and cook it by the absorption method or in a rice cooker. Keep it warm with the lid on.
Cut the pork shoulder into 3 cm pieces, trimming any large bits of fat. Toss with the soy sauce, egg, crushed garlic and a pinch of salt, then set aside to marinate for 15 minutes.
Cut the capsicums and onion into bite-size chunks. Drain the pineapple pieces, keeping 60 ml of the juice.
Stir the tomato sauce, brown sugar, white vinegar and reserved pineapple juice together in a jug until the sugar dissolves. Set aside.
Tip the cornflour over the marinated pork and toss until every piece is well coated.

Pour the vegetable oil into a large deep frying pan to a depth of about 1 cm and set it over medium-high heat. Fry the pork in batches for 5-6 minutes, turning, until deep golden and cooked through. Drain on paper towel.

Carefully pour off all but about 1 tablespoon of the oil. Return the pan to high heat and stir-fry the capsicum and onion for 2-3 minutes until lightly charred but still crisp, then add the pineapple pieces and toss for 1 minute.
Pour in the sauce and let it bubble for 1-2 minutes until glossy and slightly thickened. Return the pork, toss to coat, and serve straight away over the rice.
